description: This file defines a custom exception class `LeaveAllocationServiceException` used within the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin. It provides static methods to generate specific exception instances for various leave-related errors, such as overlapping leaves, work shift length issues, leave balance limits, and date constraints.

classes.name: LeaveAllocationServiceException
classes.description: Custom exception class for leave allocation-related errors, extending PHP's built-in Exception class. Provides static factory methods for specific error instances.

methods.name: overlappingLeavesFound
methods.description: Factory method returning an instance indicating overlapping leave requests were found.

methods.name: workShiftLengthExceeded
methods.description: Factory method returning an instance indicating the work shift length has been exceeded.

methods.name: leaveBalanceExceeded
methods.description: Factory method returning an instance indicating the leave balance has been exceeded.

methods.name: leaveQuotaWillExceed
methods.description: Factory method returning an instance indicating the leave quota will be exceeded.

methods.name: noWorkingDaysSelected
methods.description: Factory method returning an instance indicating no working days have been selected.

methods.name: cannotApplyLeaveBeyondMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Factory method returning an instance indicating leave cannot be applied beyond the maximum allowed end date.

methods.name: cannotAssignLeaveBeyondMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Factory method returning an instance indicating leave cannot be assigned beyond the maximum allowed end date.
